item.title: Remembering John Beam: Former players and students honor legendary coach in Oakland
item.description: "We lost a giant." Hundreds gathered Friday night in Oakland to honor a legend larger than life who helped transform their very own lives. Coach John Beam.

item.title: 2026 World Cup matches: Who's playing at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara?
item.description: Here's what we know about who's playing in the FIFA World Cup at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara in 2026.

item.title: Magnitude-7.0 earthquake hits remote wilderness along Alaska-Canada border
item.description: A powerful, magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck in a remote area near the border between Alaska and the Canadian territory of Yukon.

item.title: Waymo issues voluntary recall after recorded issues in Texas; vehicles will remain on roads
item.description: In a statement to ABC7, Waymo says it is not taking its robotaxis off the roads for the recall. It says all vehicles had a software update by Nov. 17.

item.title: 25-story housing proposal at SF Marina Safeway site draws both praise and criticism
item.description: The site of the original Marina Safeway could become a 25-story housing development, with 790 apartment units, if a real estate development company has its way. But there's already pushback to the large project.

item.title: Hegseth defends strikes on alleged cartel boats, says Trump can order use of force 'as he sees fit'
item.description: Hegseth dismissed criticism of the strikes on alleged drug cartel boats, which have killed more than 80 people and now face intense scrutiny over concerns that they violated international law.

item.title: 1 killed, more than 20 poisoned by death cap mushrooms in California, officials say
item.description: California officials are warning foragers after an outbreak of poisoning linked to wild mushrooms that has killed one adult and caused severe liver damage in several patients, including children. "Death cap mushrooms contain potentially deadly toxins that can lead to liver failure."

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly overnight with fog
item.description: It will be chilly overnight with tule fog and a marine layer developing in the early hours.

item.title: North Bay tenants fight eviction from affordable housing complex originally built for farmworkers
item.description: With just weeks before Christmas, families are facing the stress of eviction from a new affordable housing complex in Sebastopol. Tenants were allowed to move into the units earlier this year, but were later told they had to go because the housing was built for farmworkers and their families.

item.title: National Park Service drops free admission on MLK Day, Juneteenth while adding Trump's birthday
item.description: The National Park Service will offer free admission on President Donald Trump's birthday next year -- which also happens to be Flag Day -- but is eliminating the benefit for Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Juneteenth.
